baseline_models.focus_anchor: The definite feminine subject at focus word 2 precedes the passive verb at word 3, so the destroyed person occupies the clause's grammatical center.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ordinary asking remains primary, but the passive construction makes the formerly silenced victim the person formally addressed. The question therefore restores a respondent position before any answer or accusation is supplied.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary act of asking supplies the speech event, while its passive focus makes address itself the mechanism of restored standing.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely reports that a question is put to a victim.
changed_reading.after: The act of putting the question already reverses erasure by recognizing the victim as an addressable subject.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 3 carries a field that includes both asking and the thing sought, while the passive subject remains the person to whom the event is directed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The lexical movement from a sought request to its fulfillment lets the scene carry two directions at once: information may be requested from the victim, yet the hearing may also receive a claim that belongs to her. Her role is not exhausted by supplying facts.

activation_trace.role: The sought request turns the content of questioning into a possible unmet claim carried by the victim.
The fulfillment branch makes the hearing itself capable of granting standing to that claim rather than only extracting an answer.

changed_reading.before: The verb seeks information from her.
changed_reading.after: The same event can also be a hearing in which her denied claim is finally admitted and, at least procedurally, answered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive focus verb at word 3 addresses the victim without naming an interrogator, leaving the speaking relation structurally open.
baseline_models.mechanism: A reciprocal-questioning branch activates a forum rather than a one-way examination. The morphology is not itself reciprocal, but the unnamed questioner and centered respondent permit the act to reopen relation after a radically one-sided death.

activation_trace.role: Mutual questioning supplies the live image of an exchange, functioning here as a cautious expansion of the passive hearing into a forum.

changed_reading.before: An authority interrogates a passive victim.
changed_reading.after: The clause opens a forum in which the victim is returned to a relation of address and possible reply, even though the exchange remains asymmetric.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's split mapping attaches an extraction image directly to the focus verb at word 3; the definite subject at word 2 supplies an enclosed victim only as a structural cue.
baseline_models.mechanism: The non-dominant mapped branch recasts questioning as a gentle drawing-out from concealment. On this reading the question does not wait for recovery and then begin; asking is itself the operation that extracts suppressed testimony into audibility.

activation_trace.role: A gentle, hidden extraction supplies the material image, and the reading assigns the interrogative act the role of drawing testimony out of concealment.

changed_reading.before: Questioning occurs after the victim has been recovered.
changed_reading.after: Questioning is the recovery operation: it draws the buried testimony out while preserving the scene's quiet, passive grammar.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purposeful gathering, the self as a whole identity, and the joining of one thing to another turn the reciprocal baseline into a social reversal. The isolated victim is not merely retrieved; she is reinserted into an assembly whose relations have been recomposed before she is addressed.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning keeps the focus event open as a forum rather than a one-directional demand.
Gathering a group toward a purpose supplies the convening action that gives the later question an assembled setting.
The thing in its own identity keeps each gathered self irreducible, allowing the victim to return as a particular person rather than an anonymous case.
Joining one thing as a counterpart to another supplies the relational repair that turns isolation into participation.

structural_cues: The focus follows a run of fronted nouns undergoing passive transformations, and 81:7 places recomposed selves immediately before the victim's passive questioning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, individuated selves, pairing, and reciprocal questioning; I supply the arrow from those operations to a convened hearing. A live alternative is that the sequence only enumerates separate transformations without constructing a forum.

changed_reading.before: A solitary victim is questioned in an unspecified scene.
changed_reading.after: The question is the culminating social act of reassembling an excluded person into a purposeful community of respondents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier image of ten-month gestation being left empty or unattended activates the split focus image of extracted offspring. The victim can therefore register not only a life ended but a future and lineage removed from their source; the hearing calls that interrupted futurity back into account.

activation_trace.role: Extracted offspring or lineage supplies the form-distant focus image through which the victim also signifies a severed future.
Ten-month gestation supplies a nearby image of life at the threshold of continuation.
Emptiness and abandonment convert gestational potential into neglected futurity, preparing the focus reversal.

structural_cues: Both 81:4 and 81:8 place a definite feminine subject before a feminine passive verb; the missing-inventory focus root at word 2 is used only to locate the victim in that parallel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gestation, abandonment, and the split image of extracted lineage; I infer a shared axis of interrupted futurity. The alternative is that the gestational image concerns only the earlier subject and should not transfer to the victim.

changed_reading.before: The hearing concerns one completed killing.
changed_reading.after: The hearing also makes the victim stand for the future and lineage that the killing extracted from possibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next clause supplies the question's alleged fault and completed killing. Because the killed person is the one asked and no fault is asserted, the impossible demand for a justifying offense reverses evidentiary pressure: the victim is the grammatical respondent, but the killers' act becomes the thing on trial.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary asking supplies the procedural frame whose direction is revised by the content that follows.
Fault or offense supplies the proposed ground, and its interrogative rather than assertive presentation leaves the victim uncharged.
The taking of life fixes the actual deed under examination and redirects the question toward its agents and justification.

structural_cues: 81:9 is syntactically continuous with the passive asking in 81:8 and supplies an interrogative cause rather than a quoted answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asking, alleged fault, killing, and the immediate question sequence; I infer that an unanswerable justification indicts the deed and its agents. A live alternative is a lament that exposes innocence without functioning as a forensic burden shift.

changed_reading.before: The victim is interrogated as though she must account for herself.
changed_reading.after: Her formal questioning is a forensic device that leaves her innocent and forces the killing, its rationale, and its agents into the dock.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus extraction image is followed by written surfaces opened and a covering removed. Together they turn asking into procedural exhumation: the concealed case is drawn out, spread into a public record, and stripped of the cover that had kept it unavailable.

activation_trace.role: Hidden drawing-out makes the focus question the first movement from concealment into evidence.
The written sheet supplies an inspectable evidentiary surface for what the question draws out.
Opening and spreading converts a closed record into public availability.
Removing a cover and revealing what was hidden supplies the final disclosure operation applied to the case.

structural_cues: The question and killing are followed immediately by two more feminine passive unveilings, first of records and then of the overhead covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extraction, a written surface, opening, and uncovering; I supply the procedural arrow from those material acts to exhumation and publication of the crime. The alternative is that records and sky remain separate eschatological objects.

changed_reading.before: The question is a private exchange with a recovered victim.
changed_reading.after: The question unseals the buried case and places it on an opened, publicly inspectable record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later knowledge, the self in its own identity, and bringing something into presence show that the question need not fill an information gap. It can perform disclosure by making the particular victim and what happened to her present as known evidence.

activation_trace.role: Asking supplies the surface speech act whose information-seeking function is revised into evidentiary manifestation.
Disclosure to a knower supplies an epistemic endpoint that does not depend on obtaining new facts from the victim.
Identity in itself preserves the victim's particularity within the general disclosure of what each self has brought.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness supply the act by which hidden history becomes evidence at hand.

structural_cues: No answer is quoted; the sequence instead culminates in each self knowing what it has made present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asking, disclosure, particular selfhood, and presence; I infer that the question causes manifestation rather than repairs ignorance. The alternative is a conventional rhetorical question whose only function is rebuke.

changed_reading.before: The question awaits information that the victim must provide.
changed_reading.after: The posing of the question is itself disclosure: it makes the victim and crime present as already knowable evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Retreat into hiding, disappearance into shelter, thinning darkness, and breath emerging from within create a temporal route for the split focus image of slipping out. The question becomes a threshold at which suppressed voice leaves enclosure and enters audibility like dawn taking breath.

activation_trace.role: Slipping out from a constricted or crowded place supplies the focus movement from burial-like enclosure toward voice.
Retreat into concealment establishes the hidden phase from which the victim's voice must emerge.
Disappearance into a hiding place thickens the image of temporarily unavailable witness rather than permanently erased voice.
Darkness thinning at a boundary supplies the transitional opening through which the voice can return.
Breath issuing from an interior gives the emerging testimony an embodied acoustic form.

structural_cues: After the judgment sequence, 81:15-81:18 move through hiding and night into morning breath, forming a reversible concealment-to-emergence pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, hiding, boundary-darkness, breath, and a split slipping-out image; I infer an acoustic return of suppressed testimony. The live alternative is that the oath sequence authenticates later speech without modeling the victim's voice.

changed_reading.before: The victim speaks, if at all, in a static posthumous hearing.
changed_reading.after: Her questioning marks a threshold where a voice forced into concealment re-enters the world as breath and audibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Uttered speech, message-bearing, trust, clear disclosure, hidden material, and refusal to withhold form a chain of custody around the reported question. The victim's answer need not be quoted for the event to work as deposition; the formally transmitted posing of the question certifies that her case has entered authoritative speech.

activation_trace.role: The asking event supplies the deposition-like act whose report will receive contextual authentication.
Speech brought into utterance gives the earlier unquoted hearing a transmissible verbal form.
Messenger and message supply an identifiable carrier for the transmitted question.
Security of heart and trust supplies the reliability condition for receiving the report.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign makes authentication an act of clarification rather than mere authority.
What is hidden from eyes matches the victim's unavailable case and identifies the material needing transmission.
Withholding or hoarding supplies the blocked action that the report explicitly reverses.

structural_cues: The victim's answer is absent, while 81:19-81:24 repeatedly validate the source, carrier, visibility, and release of the discourse that contains her question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, carrier, trust, disclosure, hiddenness, and non-withholding; I transfer that authentication to the reported hearing as a deposition-like chain of custody. The alternative is that these cues authenticate only the revelation as a whole and do not specialize the victim's scene.

changed_reading.before: The scene is an imagined dialogue whose missing answer leaves its evidentiary status open.
changed_reading.after: The scene is an authenticated deposition: transmitting that the victim was formally asked is itself authoritative evidence of her restored case.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later challenge about where the plural audience is going supplies a second direction of interrogation. Reciprocal questioning now operates across the discourse: the victim is first made respondent, then the hearers who witness her case must account for their own path.

activation_trace.role: Mutual questioning supplies the focus potential for the interrogative relation to reverse direction.
Going and passing supply the audience's actionable direction as the object of the later challenge.
A path as both route and way of conduct turns physical direction into the hearers' accountable orientation.

structural_cues: 81:8 asks the singular feminine victim, whereas 81:26 directly challenges a plural audience; the change in addressee transfers the respondent role.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal questioning and the audience's path; I infer that the second question returns the burden opened by the first onto the hearers. The alternative is a general challenge about belief with no special return to the victim's case.

changed_reading.before: The audience watches the victim answer from outside the scene.
changed_reading.after: Her question turns through the discourse and places the audience in the respondent position: their chosen path is now under examination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Restored memory, a documentary token of right, a guiding mark, and straightening convert the victim's sought claim into a portable instrument. The scene does not only disclose a past wrong; remembering her question becomes a means by which later hearers can detect and correct their direction.

activation_trace.role: The sought claim supplies the right that the later reminder can preserve and carry.
Bringing something back after forgetting makes the victim's case recurrent rather than confined to one hearing.
A mention of right functioning as deed or document gives remembrance a juridical, portable form.
A distinguishing sign that guides to its object makes the remembered case diagnostic for later conduct.
Straightness, balance, and levelness supply the corrective outcome toward which the remembered right points.

structural_cues: The reminder follows the audience-directed question and is immediately specified for whoever seeks to become straight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sought claim, restored memory, a document of right, a guiding sign, and straightening; I infer a causal arrow from remembering the victim's case to ethical correction. The alternative is that the reminder guides generally without making this scene a specific rights instrument.

changed_reading.before: The question adjudicates a singular past crime.
changed_reading.after: The question becomes a durable document of right whose remembrance can diagnose and straighten future conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The victim's recognition as an answerable subject is extended into the audience's willing and rising toward straightness, while the repeated will and sovereign completion prevent that agency from becoming isolated self-causation. The focus thus initiates a bounded chain of responsible subjecthood rather than merely displaying a passive object.

activation_trace.role: Direct address recognizes the victim as answerable and supplies the first recovered subject position in the model.
Will attached to an object supplies the audience's directed agency rather than an abstract capacity.
Resolute rising toward a matter turns will into responsible movement after the victim's case is heard.
The doubled occurrence nests creaturely willing within another will and therefore bounds the agency activated by address.
Sovereignty supplies the encompassing authority within which victim and audience receive accountable standing.
Nurturing and bringing to completion keeps sovereignty constructive, allowing restored subjecthood to aim at completion rather than mere judgment.

structural_cues: The focus victim is grammatically passive yet personally addressed; the closing verses move from a singular willing hearer to nested plural and divine willing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies address, directed will, rising, nested will, sovereignty, and completion; I infer a progression from restored respondent status to bounded moral agency. The alternative is that the final will statements regulate only the audience and do not alter the victim's role.

changed_reading.before: The victim remains only the passive object of an event done to her.
changed_reading.after: Being addressed restores a minimal subject position that the discourse extends to accountable hearers, while locating every act of will within a larger sovereignty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines a non-dominant chain image at the focus verb with the immediate context's tail and follower images. It remains anchored to the question about the killing and to a branch that exposes someone to death, but downstream prose should present it as a causal-social analogy, not as a lexical translation of the surface words.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split-mapped focus verb at word 3 supplies chainlike connection, while the next clause specifies the victim's killing as the matter being questioned.

activation_trace.role: Chainlike linkage supplies a model in which the question connects successive contributors rather than stopping at one hand.
A tail or terminal part supplies the backward-traceable end of a causal sequence attached to the killing.
Followers and appendages widen accountability from an initiating agent to those who continue or support the act.
Exposing a person to killing supplies an enabling role distinct from directly taking life.

changed_reading.before: The question seeks one direct killer and one motive.
changed_reading.after: The question can trace a chain of exposure, following, enabling, and direct action through which the victim was delivered to death.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The branch literally concerns fulfillment of a request rather than passive interrogation, so the transfer is form-distant. It remains attached to the focus verb and is reinforced by later nearness and presence; downstream prose should say that the hearing symbolically or procedurally grants her claim, not that the grammar literally means her request was fulfilled.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 3 contains a fulfillment branch, and the victim's placement as passive subject makes the hearing itself the only explicit action performed for her.

activation_trace.role: Fulfilling a request supplies the reversal by which convening the hearing can count as answering the victim's denied claim.
Movement forcefully toward nearness supplies restoration from exclusion into an accessible hearing.
Presence and witnessing make the granted element concrete: her case is finally brought near and made attendable.

changed_reading.before: The victim is asked to satisfy someone else's demand for an answer.
changed_reading.after: The very act of bringing her near and hearing her can be carried as the first fulfillment of her own denied demand for recognition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This hydrological reading is deliberately cross-domain: a split focus branch supplies a water channel, while the nearby sea can be filled or depleted. It remains anchored to the focus verb as a passage-making image and to the enclosed subject as a structural cue, but downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for released testimony, never as a proposed dictionary sense of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split-mapped focus verb at word 3 supplies a narrow channel, and the definite subject at word 2 is used only structurally as the concealed source from which testimony must pass.

activation_trace.role: A narrow channel where water slips or gathers supplies the question as a passage opened for blocked voice.
A wide fissure supplies the larger breached medium into which the narrow testimonial channel can open.
Filling with water supplies accumulated pressure and stored testimony behind the passage.
Water emptying or receding supplies release through the opened channel and preserves the branch inventory's live reversal.

changed_reading.before: The question is a discrete sentence spoken to the victim.
changed_reading.after: The question can be imagined as a channel breached through concealment, allowing accumulated and blocked testimony to discharge into the open.

strongest_changes: Passive address restores the erased victim as a respondent and claimant rather than leaving her an object.
The immediate fault-and-killing clause converts apparent interrogation of the victim into an indictment of the deed, its rationale, and its agents.
Extraction, opened records, uncovering, knowledge, and presence make the question an exhuming and publicly disclosing act rather than a request for unknown facts.
Later authentication and the audience-directed path question carry the hearing outward: the report is warranted, and the hearers become respondents.
Memory as a document of right and straightening turns the singular case into a durable corrective instrument without collapsing it into a general theme.
summary.what_was_special: The split mapping on the focus verb kept ordinary asking beside hidden extraction, lineage, linkage, slipping-out, and channel images. Contextual passive reversals, gestation and abandonment, public records, unveiling, dawn breath, authenticated transmission, redirected questioning, and nested will then produced several coexisting juridical, spatial, material, social, mnemonic, and agential readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which the non-dominant mapped branches should color the surface focus verb remains uncertain; they are retained as activations, not lexical replacements.
Reciprocity and request-fulfillment may describe the hearing's function more securely than the verb's morphology.
The authentication sequence may validate the discourse globally without functioning as a specialized chain of custody for the victim's scene.
The focus root listed without a branch inventory was used only through word order, definiteness, gender, and passive syntax; no branch-level semantics were invented for it.
